critique.evidence: Measured rendering is demo-ready across all three viewports: FCP 52–76 ms, LCP 548–704 ms, TTFB 1.3–5.8 ms, and load/DOMContentLoaded 141–237 ms. CLS is excellent on desktop/mobile (0.001/0) and acceptable on tablet (0.0478). No console, page, or request failures occurred; all tested APIs returned 200, no horizontal overflow was measured, and frame sampling found no long frames. The main constraints are a 1,148,898-byte JS payload, 1,314,022 total transfer bytes, and weaker desktop frame cadence at 20.73 ms average with a 33.4 ms worst frame. No measured /compose response duration was supplied.
critique.fix: Code-split and tree-shake the 1.15 MB JavaScript bundle, defer code for the other 11 screens, and profile the desktop interaction/render path to keep frames under 16.7 ms. Add explicit measured POST /compose latency under throttled network and CPU conditions, and reserve tablet layout space to reduce its 0.0478 CLS.
